Kharge seeks FIR over alleged 'purification' ritual post-Haldwani rally

Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge has written to BJP President J.P. Nadda requesting an FIR be filed concerning an alleged 'purification' ritual that took place after a rally in Haldwani. The ritual reportedly involved the alleged humiliation of Congress workers. Kharge stated that such actions are unacceptable and violate democratic principles. He urged Nadda to ensure appropriate action is taken to prevent similar incidents.
